edits.new: Identify restrictions on the parent's whole scope and restrictions on a particular kind or activity it covers. For each alternative the child admits, establish coverage through at least one kind or activity the parent covers, preserving all applicable restrictions. A counterexample must fall outside every alternative the parent admits. Check independently required conditions separately, even when they appear in one phrase.
